review:
Tai the Toad is a 5×5 paylines slot with a wealth and prosperity theme and a 7,500x max win, reachable in the base game and in both bonus modes. Toad symbols are reveal symbols: when the Prosperity Pot lands, every Toad reveals the same thing, either Wilds or Gold Coins.

Gold Coins are scatter cash prizes from 1x to 1,000x the bet, added together. Toads can also reveal Coin Bags, which multiply one to five Gold Coins. There are two bonus modes, the Toad Bonus and Golden Toad Bonus. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP or volatility outside the game. It suits players who like coin-collecting games.
